prompt: Create one continuous 10-second photoreal novel-view shot of the SAME STATIC physical scene. @Image1 is a real photograph, uniformly scaled and cropped, of the STARTING camera view. It is the authority for object identity, observed construction, materials, colors, lighting, and scene details. It is NOT a character sheet, flat backdrop, or frame to repeat. @Video1 is a procedural geometric reconstruction of that SAME scene. Follow its camera translation, local arc, framing progression, relative depth and changing occlusion. Replace its simplified CG surfaces with the real photographed appearance from @Image1; do not copy low-poly shading or transform the scene into a cartoon. Scene identity: A stationary, weathered green-and-orange diesel locomotive numbered 713, seen from a low front-left three-quarter view. Its long hood, cab, vents, handrails, steps, bogies and coupler lead into attached rail cars on gravel tracks. A traffic cone, yard containers, hills, trees, blue sky and a parked white pickup establish depth. Camera route: New continuous full-surround orbit for all ten seconds, clockwise in the pipeline bearing convention. First cross the nose, then sweep the unseen side, crane above the coupled rear, and descend along the source side. Four smooth velocity surges never stop or reverse. Dolly radius grows from 12.41 to over 18.8 units while the camera cranes from 1.732 to 8.4 units; no destination and no ending hold.  KINETIC CAMERA CONTRACT: @Video1 has highest authority for continuous camera motion. @Image1 controls appearance only and must not anchor, slow, recenter or stop the camera. Camera intent: An energetic inspection flight around the complete stationary locomotive: nose reveal, far-side running gear sweep, elevated coupled-rear reveal and descending source-side pass. Maintain physical rail and wheel parallax, with continuing angular speed through the final frame. Travel continuously through one 359-degree clockwise path over all ten seconds. Screen-space travel: Initially travel left across the 713 nose: the broad lettered side narrows and the nose turns frontal, then the unphotographed opposite side opens. Continue the same clockwise direction over the coupled rear; the lettered source side opens again before passing the starting bearing. There is no destination framing and no final hold: every second must contain strong world-space camera displacement, parallax and changing occlusion. Required camera beats: (1) 0–2.5s: Sweep across the orange front handrails and 713 numberboard, dollying outward as the opposite front stair becomes visible. (2) 2.5–5s: Broadside far-side pass with a rising crane: axles, brake rods, battery doors and paired louvers separate from the parallel rails. (3) 5–7.5s: Elevated rear pass clears the stationary coupled black locomotive; reveal rooftop fan grilles, rear platform, both rail lines and the passenger-car roofs. (4) 7.5–10s: Descend and dolly inward along the photographed lettered side; cone crosses against bogies, nose grows again, and the orbit remains in motion at the last frame. Required changing-occlusion evidence: (1) The front-left orange stair rail first separates from the green 713 nose and then crosses it as the camera passes the center of the nose. (2) The far-side bogies, louvers and rear platform replace the initial WESTERN PACIFIC broadside; foreground rails slide independently of the container and hills. (3) Crane over the coupled rear exposes the roof fans, rear door and connecting coupler while the black switching locomotive overlaps the passenger cars. (4) The orange cone returns from behind the locomotive to the source-side ballast foreground while the lettered long hood opens and then foreshortens toward the final moving frame. Never settle into a hero frame, pause for the action, reverse direction, rotate the subject as a turntable, or replace physical camera travel with digital zoom/pan. Begin at the photographed source composition, then reveal a coherent local novel view with clear foreground/background parallax. Only the camera moves; keep all physical objects and materials fixed. The locomotive and all rail cars remain stationary. Preserve the green/orange 713 engine, long hood, rails, bogies, coupler and track alignment. No driver, passenger or other person appears. The real photograph and proxy share the same centered 16:9 aspect-ratio crop. Preserve that crop without stretching, zooming past it, or inventing scene content outside the photographed crop. Complete newly revealed surfaces conservatively from the observed scene; Do not add, remove, morph, duplicate, rotate or animate objects. No cuts, camera jumps, turntable object motion, still-image sliding, text labels or rendered UI.
